about_the_game:
After 90 years of gliding through space, meeting nothing but… nothing. You and your crew encounters a new and unexplored planet - PEARL-34.

SOLITARY HORIZONS DEMO

In the DEMO of Solitary Horizons, you'll explore the Grassland Glade region of PEARL-34, a land shaped by a harsh, though survivable, climate.

Expect sweeping winds, sun-bleached plains, and the quiet hum of solitude that lingers just beneath the surface.

Missions Avaliable:

RESUPPLY:

You'll need to resupply, both for yourself and your spacecraft.

A CLEAR CONNECTION:

In A Clear Connection, you'll have to defend your station as your robots build and set it up around PEARL-34.

You're not just constructing, you're holding the line. Hostile forces won't wait for your systems to come online.

MINING EXPEDITION:

You'll need to gather vital crafting stones and metallum, they're your lifeline out here.

Whether you're repairing gear, powering up systems, or just staying alive, these rare resources aren't optional. They're everything.

DATA RECOVERY: 

You’ll need to download the data from your Xenostation, and defend it while the transfer runs.

Once it starts, you're a target. The signal draws attention, and not the friendly kind.



SOLE SURVIVOR

Embark on an epic journey through the planet of PEARL-34, where you are the last beacon of hope in an unforgiving universe. In "Solitary Horizons Demo" you find yourself alone, the sole survivor of your species, with only your trusty spacecraft and a loyal crew of robots to keep you company.

ADAPT

As your spacecraft hovers over an new and unexplored planet, your fate is inextricably linked to your ability to adapt and overcome the challenges that lie ahead. Survival in this new territory hinges on your resourcefulness, courage, and the bonds you make with your loyal robots.

EXPLORE, BUILD & UPGRADE

Your mission is to gather essential materials to sustain life on your spacecraft, all while navigating the treacherous landscapes of this alien world. You'll need to explore, build, and make tough decisions to secure your place in the universe.

short_description: You’re all alone in the universe, you’re the last of your kind. The only thing you have left is your spacecraft with intelligent robots. To survive, you’ll have to collect materials and supplies up to the spacecraft, and upgrade your gear. But you meet some unidentified creatures along your way.
